scope: Selected historical Astra development demonstrations, one recorded episode per persona; not a success-rate estimate or a new validation of the current runtime.
playback: Complete recorded episodes at original simulation playback rate; model inference waits are omitted. Original MP4 files are copied byte for byte, without trimming, acceleration, interpolation or re-encoding.

task87-scripted-reference.label: Scripted reference controller
task87-scripted-reference.scope: The task's own recorded reference episodes, one per persona; not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate.
task87-scripted-reference.playback: Complete recorded episodes at simulation rate (12 s, 24 fps). MP4 files are copied byte for byte, without trimming or re-encoding.
task87-scripted-reference.presentation: Scripted reference policy with explicit persona and simulator state; fixed-base G1; no perception, locomotion, or learned policy claim.
task87-scripted-reference.evaluation: Each episode passes the native evaluator for its own persona and fails it when scored against the other persona (source report.json: evaluation and wrong_persona_evaluation).

task-records-17-19.label: Scripted reference controller
task-records-17-19.scope: The task's own recorded reference episodes (task records on benchmark main); not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate.
task-records-17-19.playback: Complete recorded episodes at simulation rate (10 fps, 960×720). MP4 files are copied byte for byte, without trimming or re-encoding.
task-records-17-19.presentation: Recorded in Isaac Sim 5.1 in the furnished room with fixed-base exact-state IK and native PhysX contacts. Contact records include self and environment contacts; collision-free motion is not certified.
task-records-17-19.evaluation: Each episode passes the task's measured full-trajectory scoring for its own persona (source report.json). The reports do not score the episode against the other persona.

prb-scripted-expert-physics.label: Scripted expert
prb-scripted-expert-physics.scope: Physics episodes of the benchmark's scripted expert, which reads privileged simulator state (object poses and the persona's goal). Not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate; one passing episode per persona was chosen for visual clarity.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.playback: Complete recorded episodes at 1× simulated time (every second recorded state, 15 fps). 1280×720 H.264: the room view with a robot head-camera inset.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.presentation: Simulated in Isaac Sim 6.0 with PhysX contacts, a kinematically commanded base (no balance controller) and assisted grasping (a hand closing within 3.5 cm of an object attaches it rigidly). The recorded scene states are re-rendered in the furnished room with persona_robot_bench/sim/render.py --gait; nothing is re-simulated. The base moves kinematically, so for display the legs are animated to step along its path (planned footsteps and G1 leg IK, sim/gait.py); recorded leg poses such as squats and leans are kept.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.evaluation: Each episode meets its own persona's goal with every object at rest and the physics checks passed (result.json outcome.personalized_success and execution.faithful), and does not meet the other persona's goal (outcome.wrong_persona_success is false).
